reviews.title: Great app, changes too frequently.
reviews.text:
Two stars temporarily. I thoroughly enjoy this app and what it has to offer for completely free. It is intuitive and allows for  the kind of creative freedom I need.

However, frequent updates has made it very difficult to keep up with and is essentially a new app every other time I open it. 

My biggest gripe is that it no longer allows what is advertised: downloading completed projects directly onto the phone. This has made the app unusable for me.

If this is an error, please consider fixing it. I have made sure to have the latest version myself. 

Thank you.

reviews.title: What’s wrong?
reviews.text:
Edits used to be the best video editing app I’ve ever used. However, since the latest update, it has become almost impossible to work with

Every time I import a video, random clips become unavailable. They turn grey, display a warning triangle with an exclamation mark, and show the message “Unable to play this video”

This happens in every single project, with all kinds of videos, regardless of file size, frame rate, or format. It is extremely frustrating and makes the app unreliable for editing

This issue only started after the latest update. Before that, everything worked perfectly. I used Edits all the time and had absolutely no complaints

Please fix this issue. I really loved this app, and it’s disappointing to see it become so difficult to use after an update

reviews.title: More time frozen than editing
reviews.text:
★☆☆☆☆ 

Edits becomes practically unusable when I try to edit anything longer than a couple of minutes. I’m working on a video just under 15 minutes, and seemingly every change makes the app freeze. Sometimes it takes up to FIVE MINUTES before I can do anything again. Then I make another edit, and the whole cycle starts over.

Trim. Freeze. Wait. Make one adjustment. Freeze again. A simple editing session turns into hours of babysitting an app that can’t keep up.

This isn’t a minor inconvenience. It makes finishing a video an exercise in frustration. What’s the point of mobile editing software if it falls apart when you actually try to edit?

Developers: please make longer projects functional on mobile devices. Until then, Edits is a patience test disguised as a video editor.

reviews.title: 1 star. And that’s generous
reviews.text:
META - yes, one of the richest companies on the planet - cannot figure out how to make subtitles follow a clip when you trim your video. You split a silence, you delete it, and every single caption shifts into the wrong place. You then spend 10 minutes fixing text instead of editing your video. Brilliant.
Oh, and the music? You get 60 or 90 seconds of a song. That’s it. No manual trim, no custom length. You work around your edit to fit their arbitrary cutoffs.
TikTok does this right. CapCut does this right. Two apps built by a Chinese company that apparently hired engineers who watched a video editor before shipping one. META has billions of dollars, thousands of developers, and a CEO who wants to be taken seriously as a tech visionary - and they cannot ship a caption layer that moves with the clip.
Fix the subtitles. Fix the music length. Or keep watching creators go back to CapCut

This app has so much potential but that is completely ruined by its glitches. What should have been a simple edit turned into an hour plus ordeal as I kept having to go back and try to replace clips whose audio randomly got taken out mid-clip for no apparent reason, only to export the video and find that a new random portion of the video had its audio cut out/removed. It freezes up often when adding multiple clips, sometimes when you’re hitting “undo” it’ll only undo the text you’re adding even when you want to undo a clip you just deleted. Sometimes you select all the clips you want for a new project, it NEVER loads and you’ll have to exit and redo that. When exiting while it’s glitching, it doesn’t save your edits and you have to do it all over again. Also when editing a clip, if you click play it’ll restart all the way at the beginning of the video over and over again instead of where you want it to play… it’s unavoidable when it starts doing this. I love how easy this app is to use and the text options, but it has too many bugs. Also lots of the sound effects are corny and would never be used in a reel.

reviews.title: Great AI, but Extremely Buggy and Limited for Serious Work
reviews.text:
This app has great AI tools and some unique features that CapCut doesn’t have, but it’s incredibly buggy and unreliable. 
I’ve reset my phone, deleted and reinstalled the app, duplicated projects, and even started over many times—but the same issues keep happening.

Main bugs:
Audio becomes delayed by a few seconds after clicking play.

Display window breaks randomly, making editing impossible.

I often can’t select clips or overlays properly; sometimes I can only select them when I don’t click directly on them.

Overlays and assets randomly disappear.

Mask tool freezes the frame instead of masking (exports look fine, but editing is broken).

Keyframes disappear or stop working randomly.

App slows down at random times, buffers endlessly, and sometimes crashes completely.

It’s very frustrating—one 20-second clip took me 2.5 hours to edit because of these bugs. 

I use this app for professional projects, but it’s becoming impossible to rely on.

Feature requests:

Freeze frame
Exposure and contrast control per clip
Better audio control (volume higher than max)
Speed ramping
Motion blur
Stabilization
More sound effects and overlays

CapCut has many of these features, and this app could easily be better if it was more stable and had these tools. 

I’ve reported these issues multiple times in-app, but it seems the reports don’t go through—so I’m posting here to make sure it’s seen.

Please fix these issues. I really want to keep using this app, but it needs major stability and
